cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import random,time
for nt,nu in [(10000,65536),(10000,1000),(1000,65536),(1,65536)]:
 P=32
 rnd=random.Random(1)
 T=[rnd.getrandbits(nt) for _ in range(P)]
 U=[rnd.getrandbits(nu) for _ in range(P)]
 allT=(1<<nt)-1; allU=(1<<nu)-1
 rules=[]; checks=[0]; nodes=[0]
 def rec(start,combo,cov):
  nodes[0]+=1
  for p in range(start,P):
   nc=cov|T[p]; cc=combo+(p,)
   if nc==allT:
    checks[0]+=1
    ok=True; wt=[]
    for q in cc:
     o=0
     for x in cc:
      if x!=q:o|=T[x]
     e=T[q]&allT&~o
     if not e:ok=False;break
     wt.append((e&-e).bit_length()-1)
    if ok:
     uu=0
     for x in cc:uu|=U[x]
     f=allU&~uu
     if f:rules.append((cc,wt,f&-f))
   else: rec(p+1,cc,nc)
 st=time.time(); rec(0,(),0)
 print('nt nu',nt,nu,'time',time.time()-st,'rules',len(rules),'checks',checks[0],'nodes',nodes[0])
PY
